question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

People are acting the way evolution have wired them.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the verb "**have**" which should be "**has**."
 
• The subject "**evolution**" is singular and requires the singular verb "**has**."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**the way evolution has wired them**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"People are acting the way evolution **has** wired them."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "No error"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 3.
 
• **2: "the way evolution"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4: "People are acting,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
